title: Solutions for Hecke Sum Questions of Banerjee and Bringmann
summary: We previously conjectured a Hecke-type identity for a series arising from two-color partitions. Banerjee and Bringmann proved the conjecture using modular methods and asked for a direct proof using Bailey pairs. They also suggested investigating the odd part of the series. We answer both questions by applying Bailey's transform to a Bailey pair of Andrews and a conjugate Bailey pair of Lovejoy. Our main theorem gives formulas for the even and odd parts of a series $P_a(q)$ depending on a parameter $a$.
